presentation.label: DIFFUSED SPACE
presentation.summary: A diffused reverb with a modulated tail.
presentation.overview: A compact diffused reverb with a modulated tail. Control its length and darkness, then use modulation depth and rate to add movement to the space.
usage: Choose MINI VERB in FX2. DECAY controls the tail; higher DAMP makes the sound darker.
MOD sets modulation depth and RATE selects one of eight modulation speeds. Use MIX to place the reverb behind the dry signal.
The delay ring clears progressively on initialization. Audio stays dry until the ring is ready.

controls.name: MOD
controls.doc: two in-loop allpasses; smoothed 0..64 sample depth

limitations: The documented sweep exercises moving controls, trigger splits and eight instances for 4,096 blocks per case. The README explicitly says it has not been flashed or verified on hardware.

storage.label: DSP program / buffer
storage.conditions: Per-instance Y ring allocation; 13,750 positions are occupied by the documented layout.

processing.label: DSP instruction peak
processing.conditions: Worst tested case with eight instances, four per core, at 44.1 kHz and 16-sample blocks. Excludes dispatcher, voice engines, other effects and hardware stalls.

access.location: Audio track FX2 SETUP: Mini Verb in the effect chooser.
steps: Select an audio track with its TRACK key.
Hold FUNC and press FX2 to open FX2 SETUP.
Turn LEVEL to Mini Verb and press YES to assign it.
Press FX2 to close SETUP, then adjust DECAY, DAMP, MIX, MOD and RATE.
